name: minimind
description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
one_liner: A recipe and code for training your own tiny AI language model from scratch cheaply and quickly, instead of only ever using someone else's.
buyer: A coding bootcamp or university lecturer who wants a hands-on 'build your own LLM' workshop for students.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp sells a paid weekend workshop where students train their own small language model from scratch.
An online course platform packages it as a 'how LLMs really work' hands-on module.
A corporate trainer uses it to demystify AI for a non-technical leadership team via a live, cheap demo.

money_ideas.idea: Ticket sales for a paid workshop or cohort course built around the repo
Subscription access to an online course platform hosting the material

steal_this: Turn the repo into a paid one-day 'train your own tiny LLM' workshop for a local coding meetup.
